sourceManifest.scope: Literal local import closure of this direct actual-source run, including this exact runner.

sourceBinding.normProducer: The private actual ell=1 run supplies the fixed source background/leading-field/norm definitions only. Its pulse is not reused or declared admissible.
sourceBinding.newOperator: New original-form geometry, both rounded frozen carriers, moving-normal pressure, moving basis, full Volterra solution and covariance integrals at ell=ellMinimum+8.
sourceBinding.supportProducer: Actual completed all-order background and original common-support/moment recipe; all positive-order fields vanish on the declared terminal annulus for every q.
sourceBinding.targetProducer: The actual full heat/B8/C12/I1/I2 leading stress and both viscous shear terms. No target values or bounds are supplied by a caller.

selection.appliesTo: Every original integer band ell>=ellMinimum and every certified slow box intersected with the original source closed annulus.
selection.sourceDependencies: Fixed actual n1/n2 C2 finite block, the canonical all-n tail, fixed leading enlarged C2 and leading source direction/geometry.

quantitative.positivityDomain: The selected fixed band; Xplus<X_rep<Xb and Xplus<X<Xb, eta_rep,eta in[-1,1], s_rep,s in[1/2,2], same slow box distance<=4/S^3. Representatives and rounded labels are frozen for slow differentiation.

commonSupport.base: The actual n=1 moment-completed profiles have the checked zero after-branches. The actual source support-order proof puts every repair endpoint before Xplus.
commonSupport.step: For every integer n>=2, completeOrder uses the same bootstrap endpoints: local F/U vanish after Xcut, dF/dU after IposRight, M and average after lastU, and Pi after Xplus. The formula for v uses U, average and its eta derivative. These statements hold for arbitrary inner bodies and moment debts; no bound on n or generated-prefix extrapolation is used.
commonSupport.smoothJets: All endpoints are eta independent and the fields are the original smooth moment-completed fields. An identically-zero open exterior therefore has every finite X/eta derivative zero.
commonSupport.completeSeries: For every q>0, local finiteness follows from c_n>=2^n. Each positive-order summand and its cutoff/extra-stream derivatives is exactly zero on X>Xplus. Hence the complete source and every finite q/X/eta jet equal the leading source on this open annulus.
commonSupport.scope: This equality is restricted to X>Xplus. It does not discard possibly active coefficients on X<=Xplus or certify the stress/residual estimates.

selectedBand.definition: ell*=ellMinimum+8, Q*=2^(-ell*), S*=ell*^2, q=Q* s with 1/2<=s<=2.
selectedBand.membership: ellMinimum=ceil(max(8,Sminimum,(64/h)^2)) is a positive integer. Thus ell*>ellMinimum and S*>=Sminimum. All actual frame/concentration/source-direction conditions are met.
selectedBand.frequency: The original log estimate gives S*^2*(epsilon+epsilon^2+1/k)<1; all source h, epsilon and the integer ceiling k remain exact.
selectedBand.qStar: 2Q*=2^(-ellMinimum-7)=qStar/8, so the whole selected physical band lies strictly below the source-certified qStar.
selectedBand.palette: For a=((1+h)ell* log2-2logell*)/logTg and m=floor(a), 0<=a-m<1 gives 1/(Tg*S*)<ci<=1/S*. Therefore 2r0<=Ls/S*<2r0*Tg. No floating logarithm or ceiling is evaluated.

sourceTransfer.completedField: On both the representative and slow-point terminal neighborhoods the full original completed F/G and all finite slow derivatives equal the retained leading functions. The fixed source C2 constants therefore still bound the actual new coefficients, with completed-leading error exactly zero there.

originalBounds.profilePath: Connect (s,X,eta) by its straight path inside [1/2,2]x[Xa/2,2Xb]x[-1,1]. For its slow image, both chart and inverse endpoint difference norms are bounded by B; integrate the known slow C2 gradient along this path. Including the finite dimension/norm factors yields <=B^4*|Delta slow|, without extending the nonconvex slow image.
originalBounds.chartEndpointDifference: Subtract s-Z^2*s^(2h)-T at the two endpoint roots. With 1-8h>1/2 on s in[1/2,2], |Delta s|<=2(|Delta T|+4|Delta Z|); eta=Z/s^D and X=R^2/(2s) give the remaining bounds <=B*|Delta slow|.
originalBounds.closeFields: The source box diameter <=4/S^3, leading C2<=B and completed-leading C2<=B*epsilon^2 give |F-F0|,|FR-FR0|,|GR-GR0|<=B^5/S^3.
originalBounds.frozenPhaseCancellation: pTilde*FR0+pz*GR0 = betaTilde dot (R0*FR0,GR0) = -sign*Bs*u/Ls, since K dot g0=0 and N dot g0=|g0|.
originalBounds.rounding: Choose the nearest nonzero integer to k*pTilde, retaining its sign in the zero-rounding cell. Thus |p-pTilde|<=1/k; p is never divided into a frame coordinate.
originalBounds.tangentNormal: n_theta-pTilde/R0=(p-pTilde)/R+pTilde*(1/R-1/R0), plus the explicit -sign*Bs*u*Ntheta/(Ls*|g0|). For n_z retain both this designed O(1/Ls) tilt and -epsilon*v*(pF_Z+pzG_Z). Both are <=B^12/S.
originalBounds.positiveDenominators: Bs>=R^-40>B^-1; S>=B^512 makes |n_tan-Bs*K|<=Bs/2, so |n_tan|>=B^-2. The frozen source supplies |c0|>=R^-6>B^-1. Every division in the frame is one of these or |n|^2.
originalBounds.referenceDiagonal: At nref=Bs*(s_ref,K), project the cylindrical K0 with no geometric derivative. In Uref=[er-s_ref*K,N] this is [[0,2F0*Ntheta/(1+s_ref^2)],[-(|g0|+2F0*Ntheta),0]]. The actual c0/lambda0 definitions diagonalize it by J; all nprime and Bprime terms remain in the calculated error.
originalBounds.damping: epsilon*k^2*Bs^2=lambda0/(1+u^2)^(3/2), so epsilon*k^2*|nref|^2=dref exactly. epsilon*k^2<=4; the n-nref product bound gives Ed.

sourceTransfer.retainedFeatures: The new frame uses the original nonzero nearest-integer carrier, the n-prime pressure term and B-prime term. Its reference constants N,K,c0,lambda0 are the original leading ones.
sourceTransfer.exactSolutions: The two new Volterra systems are defined by their actual coefficient bodies and original source matrix bound. No finite display sum is identified with their limit.

positivity.radialAndMass: The Riccati invariant cone gives z_plus>0 and |z_minus/z_plus|<=coneK/S*<=1/2. Hence x=t_r>0. The original psi plateau and Haar/transverse factors give mass>=haarFactor*massLowerCoefficient*sqrt(Ls)>0.
positivity.massUpper: Since P<=1, psi<=1 and x<=amplitudeUpper*P, mass<=haarFactor*amplitudeUpper^2*Ls. This finite bound does not require a numerical H integral.
positivity.columns: Actual frame and Gaussian absolute-moment estimates imply |C-Cideal|_max<=kappa/128 with Cideal=[[1,1],[-1,1]]. All recipe constants and the stronger source selector are bound above.
positivity.determinant: The exact Bernstein audit gives 15/8<det(C)<17/8. Since det([-N/Ac;K/u])=-1/(Ac*u), det(H)=-Ac*u*mass_plus*mass_minus*det(C)<0.
positivity.weights: On the open stress shell targetScale=-(N dot T)/Ac>0, and the actual target cone plus same-box modulus gives kappa/64<=mass_sign*y_sign/targetScale<=2. Thus each actual inverse weight is strictly positive with the displayed lower and upper roots.
positivity.squareRoots: At a fixed label and frozen representative, the source, Volterra solution, H and target are smooth in the open slow chart. Nonzero determinant and strictly positive weights make their positive square roots smooth there. The quantitative square-root bounds follow from monotonicity; no flat-edge or cross-label derivative claim is made.

witness.slow: R=sqrt(2X), Z=0, T=1; distance to representative is exactly zero.
witness.terminalMembership: Xtail=Xb*exp(-3), hence log(X/Xtail)=11/4. Xplus=Xv*exp(1)<Xtail because the post-pulse interpolation alone has length128. Therefore Xplus<X<Xb.
witness.grid: Choose a slow lattice box containing this point and use the point as its representative. The original representative choice is permitted anywhere in the intersecting box; no lattice-center restriction is introduced.

boundaries.paperGamma: The paper leaves its final ell0 and qbig choices unspecified. The new actual member is in the separately source-proved covariance sufficient domain. This does not assert membership in an unspecified final Gamma or completion of its additional physical-residual conditions.
boundaries.local: Only X>Xplus is reduced. Other source boxes and the flat endpoints are not covered by this certificate.
boundaries.numerical: All tiny source parameters, full heat and huge integer-band expressions are retained. No numerical whole-H, determinant or inverse-weight interval is claimed.
boundaries.formal: Written analytic derivation plus actual AST/identity/arithmetic checks; no new analytic Lean kernel proof.
boundaries.progression: Whole G-POS, whole M2 and M3 prerequisites remain separate and unclosed.
